title: StructureTemplateLibrary
description: Named song structures as data. A template is a contract rather than a label: the lyric generator is handed it as a writing brief, the composer instantiates its bar plan against a tempo and duration, and check_lyrics.py verifies the result against it. Sections are listed one entry per occurrence in performance order, so sequence conformance is a straight comparison rather than a repeat-count calculation.

default_syllable_band.description: Inclusive lower and upper syllable count per line. Defaults to the generator's documented recommendation of 6-10.

duration_range_s.description: The usual span for this form. Used to reject a brief before generation rather than after, and to sanity-check the instantiated bar plan.

role.description: Must match a section in section-tags.json, named without its 'sec_' prefix, so a template cannot reference a section the lyric vocabulary does not know.

lines.description: Expected lyric lines. Absent for instrumental sections, which carry none.

rhyme_scheme.description: Must match an id in rhyme-schemes.json, or be null where there are no lyrics.

energy.description: The intended intensity. Checked only as a shape: a template's arc should not be flat where the form is meant to build.

optional.description: May be omitted without the template being considered unmet.

hook.description: Marks the section that carries the hook, so the checker can verify a hook exists and the oracle knows what to score.

vocals.description: Ids from the vocal_tags pool in section-tags.json: the performance mode, register and delivery for this section. They become standalone bracket tags in the lyric, placed under the section header -- [rap], [clean vocal], [powerful belting] -- which is the mechanism the model's guide presents for vocal control, as distinct from the one hyphenated modifier a section header may take.

energy_tags.description: Ids from the energy_tags pool: how this section should feel, as standalone bracket tags such as [building energy] or [vulnerable].

transition_out.description: How this section leaves, as an id from the transition_tags pool. Written in the lyric as a standalone tag at the end of the section, because a transition belongs to the section it leaves rather than the one it enters. Unlike arrangement, this is checkable: the analyser measures the boundary for the signature the transition implies.
